title: Subscription & payment engine production final report

app_ai_handoff.message: Production is fully deployed. Backend is stable. No existing customer expiries were rewritten. Subscription, payment, and activation engines verified. App AI may now perform final production verification, push GitHub, and publish the OTA.
contracts: remaining_days = EAT calendar days until expires_at (display-only)

1_active_repurchase.root_cause: create-order allowed same_device_renewal which stacked expiries
1_active_repurchase.fix: Reject with ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION_EXISTS on SonicPesa/AuraxPay/create-payment before any txn insert
1_active_repurchase.proof: Live 409 for active device 85970ee4273c6ca8 and live_act_ms0vf691_jqcgt0

2_remaining_days.root_cause: Historical stacking made expires_at far beyond plan duration; FLOOR(epoch/86400) correctly reflected stacked expiry (e.g. Wiki1 remaining_days=107). Display now uses Africa/Dar_es_Salaam calendar-day difference.
2_remaining_days.fix: SQL remaining_days uses EAT date difference; no expires_at rows rewritten
2_remaining_days.proof: New 3-day tex purchase returned remaining_days=3 matching plan_duration_days=3

3_midnight_eat.root_cause: Old math was now + N*24h with stacking
3_midnight_eat.fix: New purchases expire at 00:00 Africa/Dar_es_Salaam on purchase_EAT_date + duration_days; existing active expiries preserved
3_midnight_eat.proof: Live order osm_sp_1785014294190_aea6c0abd9 expiresAt=2026-07-28T21:00:00.000Z (29 Jul 00:00 EAT) remaining_days=3

4_activation_latency.root_cause: Webhook sync optional; status endpoint checked sub.active instead of active_now so App kept waiting after unlock
4_activation_latency.fix: Webhook sync-process default on; faster boost polls; status/verify finalize + active_now entitlement truth
4_activation_latency.proof: Live activation unlocked verify+SSE; post-fix status returns SUCCESS/ACTIVE/entitlement_active=true. Wall-clock ~20s included human STK approval; backend unlock was via boost/finalize once provider confirmed.

5_phone_collision.root_cause: Risk was phone-primary identity; production already device-bound for activation
5_phone_collision.fix: Reinforced: activation uses txn.device_id only; independent devices on same phone still allowed; active same-device repurchase blocked; auto migration remains disabled
5_phone_collision.proof: Policy tests + live create-order binds deviceId on txn; two devices same phone remain independent by design

post.note: New test activation may increment by +1; no mass expiry rewrites
